title: The Help
author: Kathryn Stockett
summary: In early 1960s Jackson, Mississippi, a young white writer secretly interviews Black maids about their work for white families, and two of the women risk everything to tell their stories.
readIf: you want a warm, readable, multi-voice novel about courage and friendship in the Civil Rights era.
skipIf: you are bothered by a white author writing Black dialect and a white-saviour framing.

pairings.reason: The classic of Southern racial injustice that this novel follows, told through a child's eyes.
Another warm Southern novel in the 1960s about women who support each other.
A deeper, harder novel about Black women's lives in the South.
